title: The passthrough "wait-timeout reconcile" test fakes a tx.wait(3) rejection that ethers 6.16.0 cannot produce: with no timeout argument the real wait never times out, so the test proves a recovery path for a failure that does not happen and stays green over the registered S1 where that wait hangs inside the nonce lock

evidence.note: case "reconciles a wait-timeout to a landed tx": wallet.sendTransaction resolves { hash, wait: mockRejectedValue(new Error("tx.wait timeout under RPC lag")) } and asserts one submit and the returned hash
the comment says "when the native tx.wait(3) TIMES OUT (the Base/Arb LADYS class)"
tx.wait(3) with no timeout; the comment claims it "may TIME OUT / reject under RPC lag"
no timer is armed when timeout is 0, so wait(3) can only settle by reaching 3 confirmations, by CALL_EXCEPTION (status 0) or by TRANSACTION_REPLACED; an RPC-lag timeout is not one of its outcomes
submitWithReconciliation awaits the submit closure with no bound (AUD-TX-002)

sibling_sites_checked: Every integration case that injects a wait() result (git grep -n "wait:" test/integration at the base SHA): mevStrategies.test.ts:81, :126, :176, :209 (Flashbots bundle wait 0), :377 (passthrough status 1), :428 (this case); txManager.test.ts:303 (bundle wait 1), :341. Only :428 injects a rejection, and it is a timeout shape ethers does not emit. No integration case leaves wait() pending, which is the real outcome.
severity_rationale: S2: a money-path test that encodes a false model of the library (it agrees with the wrong source comment at passthrough.ts:133-137), so the registered S1 AUD-TX-002 (ESC-PRE-02) passes green on the exact site it names.
recommendation: Phase 28: drive this case with a real ethers TransactionResponse on a scripted provider: (a) never mined: assert the submit returns or fails within a bounded time (fails today, RED proof for the Phase 24 fix); (b) status 0: assert CALL_EXCEPTION leads to a reverted outcome; (c) repriced replacement: assert the replacement hash is reconciled. Correct the passthrough.ts comment when the Phase 24 fix lands.
affected_cases: PassthroughMevStrategy: reconciles a wait-timeout to a landed tx and returns the real hash (no resubmit)
escaped_regression: The current code already escapes: on Base or Arbitrum a passthrough buy or sell whose tx is never mined leaves tx.wait(3) pending forever inside withNonceLock, blocking every later buy and exit of the wallet (AUD-TX-002), and this case stays green because it replaces the hang with an immediate rejection.
